pages.text: A Hunter skins what they kill: leather, hides, bones, string and monster parts give Hunter experience. Plain monster kills give little or none, animals give a bit.$(br2)Every level adds a 1% chance of an extra material (up to 40%), and a small chance of rarer parts.

Wild game counts too: deer, boars, bears, turkeys, mammoths and more drop hides, fur, fat, teeth and antlers.$(br2)Hunters also level from leatherworking (leather, leather armor, saddles, bundles, item frames, small quivers, knapsacks) and from foraging: breaking mushroom stumps and trunks.
